requirement.original: Bug #62: Session title change via change_title MCP shows service message in chat but does not update sidebar or header title. Both sessions show root (working directory basename) instead of the title set via MCP.
requirement.clarified: The change_title MCP tool handler returns success before the async updateMetadata call completes, and errors from updateMetadata are silently swallowed. The metadata update may not reach the server or the app. Fix the MCP handler to await the metadata update and propagate errors, and ensure the app properly re-renders when metadata changes.
requirement.what: Fix change_title MCP tool to properly persist session title to metadata and ensure app UI updates
requirement.why: Users (and Claude) use change_title to set meaningful session names, but the title never appears in the sidebar or header

included: Metadata update propagation from CLI to app
Sidebar and header re-rendering on metadata change
excluded: Service message display in chat (already works)

success_criteria: Sidebar shows MCP-set title within 5 seconds of tool call
Session header shows MCP-set title within 5 seconds of tool call
MCP tool returns isError:true when metadata update fails
constraints: All metadata is E2E encrypted -- must use updateMetadata path
Must maintain backward compatibility with existing metadata schema

root_cause_analysis.symptom: Session title set via change_title MCP tool shows as service message in chat but sidebar and header continue displaying working directory basename
root_cause_analysis.root_cause: The MCP handler in startHappyServer.ts calls sendClaudeSessionMessage which triggers updateMetadata asynchronously, but the handler returns success immediately without awaiting the metadata update. The updateMetadata call uses .catch() that silently swallows errors. If the metadata update fails (version mismatch, socket disconnect, timing), the title is never persisted to the server and never propagated to the app.
root_cause_analysis.root_cause_commit: 76b5cec3 - feat: add Happy MCP server for Claude-driven title management
root_cause_analysis.why_introduced: The MCP server was designed to send the summary as a Claude session message (which creates a service event in chat) but the metadata update was added as a side effect in sendClaudeSessionMessage rather than being the primary action of the handler
root_cause_analysis.why_problematic: 1) Fire-and-forget pattern means the MCP tool reports success even when metadata update fails. 2) The summary message type (line 481 of sessionProtocolMapper) produces NO session envelopes, so the only visible feedback is the tool-call service event from messageToEvent.ts, not the actual metadata change. 3) No error propagation from updateMetadata back to the MCP handler.
root_cause_analysis.timeline: Since commit 76b5cec3 (feat: add Happy MCP server for Claude-driven title management)

research_findings.reason: Straightforward bug fix with clear root cause in existing codebase -- fire-and-forget async pattern in MCP handler

context.recent_commits: 76b5cec3 feat: add Happy MCP server, 0fd4112f fix: MCP server broken by SDK 1.27

file_contents.startHappyServer.ts:63-74: MCP handler calls sendClaudeSessionMessage({type:'summary',...}) and returns {success:true} immediately. The updateMetadata inside sendClaudeSessionMessage is async with .catch() error swallowing.
file_contents.apiSession.ts:414-424: sendClaudeSessionMessage detects type=summary and calls this.updateMetadata(...).catch(). The .catch() only logs debug, does not propagate error.
file_contents.apiSession.ts:481-485: sessionProtocolMapper returns empty envelopes for summary type -- no session protocol message is sent for the summary itself.
file_contents.sessionUtils.ts:80-92: getSessionName checks session.metadata?.summary?.text first, falls back to path basename. Logic is correct.
file_contents.storageTypes.ts:31-34: MetadataSchema includes summary: z.object({text: z.string(), updatedAt: z.number()}).optional(). Schema is correct.
file_contents.sync.ts:1900-1934: update-session handler decrypts metadata and calls applySessions. Logic is correct but depends on receiving the event.
file_contents.messageToEvent.ts:48-56: Converts mcp__happy__change_title tool-call to a display-only service event. This is the chat service message that works correctly.

development_approach.strategy: Fix the MCP handler to await updateMetadata completion and propagate errors. The primary fix is in startHappyServer.ts: the handler must call updateMetadata directly (not rely on the side effect in sendClaudeSessionMessage) and await it before returning success/failure. Secondary: add a dedicated updateSessionSummary method to ApiSessionClient that both sends the summary message AND awaits the metadata update.
development_approach.validation_approach: 1) Build happy-cli. 2) Deploy to dev daemon. 3) Start a session via dev web UI. 4) Have Claude invoke change_title MCP tool. 5) Verify sidebar and header show updated title within 5 seconds. 6) Reload page and verify title persists.
